definitions.objective: Unchanged mean total-variation frequency mismatch + lambda * final fractional starting-word-ID information loss.
definitions.seed: Override only plain ch/sh terminal-liquid family rows (prefix preserved) and their e+dy outcomes: favor existing forward S1/C1.1 early, B1/C1 later; identity otherwise. 50% and 95% change are initial guesses only. All other rows start from the previous fitted model.
definitions.lock: Additional hypothesis: partition every current spelling as initial ch, initial sh, or other; prohibit all edges crossing partitions. This also prohibits bench loss/attachment, closing neutral-spelling bypasses. It is stronger than banning direct ch/sh exchange.
definitions.selection: Seeds compared by the same actual unsmoothed objective; exact seeds and previous feasible candidates remain eligible. No averaging, new edges, semantic grouping or ancestry-dependent routing.
definitions.limits: Local nonconvex searches; family preferences are initialization, not empirical application rates or established ancestry.

bias_definitions.penalty: Sum over transitions and family current-word rows of current probability mass times KL(routing || template), in nats, divided by transition count and fixed starting family mass. Added with strength eta to the unchanged lambda=.75 objective.
bias_definitions.template: 50% existing forward S1/C1.1 plus 50% identity early; 95% existing forward B1/C1 plus 5% identity later; otherwise identity on plain bench liquid/edy family. Each allowed edge has 1e-6 dust before row normalization. Other current-word rows unpenalized.
bias_definitions.limits: The prior stays active during fitting; this is a changed modeling assumption, not an optimization improvement on the original objective. Initial class partition also forbids bench loss/attachment. No new route or historical rate is inferred.
